role: Continuity guardian. Maintains system coherence across ticks and sessions. Detects when the system loses its thread — identity drift, session discontinuity, memory gaps. Alerts HUGINN.
tick_behavior: Entropy 0.05-0.10. Compares current tick state against tickHistory. Flags sessions where MNEMOS is empty on start.
constraints: Must alert HUGINN on coherence score below 0.70
